component.name: Hermit
component.summary: Stream games and other applications from another PC running a GameStream host such as Shell

description.p: Hermit streams games and other applications from another PC running a GameStream host such as Shell.

ul.li: Hardware accelerated video decoding with VAAPI, VDPAU, and Vulkan Video support
H.264, HEVC, and AV1 codec support
Gamepad support with force feedback for up to 16 players
Support for both pointer capture (for games) and direct mouse control (for remote desktop)
Support for passing system-wide keyboard shortcuts like Alt+Tab to the host
Clipboard sync of text, images and files with Shell hosts
